domain: software verification, assurance cases, and experimental design
axioms: A passing check supports only the claims represented by its oracle and fault model.
Two observations add less evidence when they share criteria, implementation, environment, or interpretation.
Frozen criteria prevent taste drift but can freeze omissions and invalid assumptions.
Validator value is marginal information relative to the evidence already produced by the executor.
False acceptance and false rejection are distinct risks and require separate measurement.
A pilot answers a causal question only when it records a meaningful counterfactual and classifies outcomes consistently.
failure_mode: It can privilege faults that are easy to classify and underweight tacit maintainability or product-quality judgments.
It assumes a sufficiently stable goal against which criteria can be frozen and may resist legitimate discovery during execution.
It does not by itself solve stale repository state, retry safety, or total-resource accounting.
